supersedes: v1 development delivery; v2 freezes restored original scope fields and comment exceptions

rules.physical: positive existing group classification; explicit contrary comment/conflict retained
rules.scopes: original physical group and user-declared comparison subsets separate; comment repairs audited
rules.difficulty: retain original similarity/difference; not a comparison admission gate
rules.quality: actual shared quality_usable, own reference, same condition and common people required separately
rules.time: source/time-binding gates independent of quality and scope
rules.closure: only directly listed group members and explicitly merged group, no cross-group transitive closure
